xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi: Notes for Statement showing shareholding pattern of the Promoter and Promoter Group: Stericon Pharma Private Limited, forming part of the Promoter Group, has been amalgamated with Aculife Healthcare Private Limited pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation approved by the Regional Director, North Western Region, Ministry of Corporate Affairs, vide Order dated 31st March, 2026. The Scheme became effective on 1st April, 2026 upon filing of Form INC-28, consequent to which Stericon Pharma Private Limited stood dissolved without winding up and accordingly its name has been removed from the Promoter Group disclosure in the Shareholding Pattern for the quarter ended on 30th June, 2026.
